text: せっかく　じーさんに　ポケモン　もらったんだぜ！

structure.jp: じーさんに　ポケモン　もらったんだぜ！
structure.en: we got Pokémon from Gramps, you know!

patterns.name: 〜にもらう
patterns.span: じーさんに　ポケモン　もらった
patterns.explanation: With もらう, 'to receive', に shows the person you get the thing from, not the person it goes to. じーさんに　ポケモン　もらった = 'got a Pokémon from Gramps'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ is the short spoken form of のだ and adds a pushing, explaining tone. もらったんだ = 'the thing is, we got them'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end of a sentence is rough, boyish talk that pushes the point at the listener. もらったんだぜ = 'we got them, man!'.
